roles.title: Managing Director
responsibilities: Leads the company and the management team in Singapore.

roles.title: Sales Manager
responsibilities: Leads the sales team and the company's largest customer accounts.

roles.title: Account Executive
responsibilities: Quotes freight rates and takes customer bookings.

roles.title: Operations Manager
responsibilities: Runs the warehouse and trucking fleet and approves the department's purchase needs.

roles.title: Shipment Coordinator
responsibilities: Plans pick-ups and deliveries and raises operational purchase requests.

roles.title: Procurement Manager
responsibilities: Chooses suppliers and signs purchase orders.

roles.title: Buyer
responsibilities: Collects supplier quotations and places purchase orders.

roles.title: Finance Manager
responsibilities: Owns budgets, payments and customer credit decisions.

roles.title: Accounts Executive
responsibilities: Invoices customers, matches supplier invoices to purchase orders and pays suppliers.

roles.title: Customer Service Manager
responsibilities: Leads customer service and handles escalated customer complaints.

roles.title: Customer Service Officer
responsibilities: Answers customers, logs complaints and raises credit requests.

relationships.description: Account Executive sends the booking confirmation to Operations.

evidence.quote: When a customer confirms a booking, the Account Executive sends the booking confirmation to Operations with the pick-up date, the cargo details and the agreed rate.
